    Auslander's coherent dual on the finite right-module skeleton #

    For a finite contravariant functor F, Auslander's coherent dual is the covariant functor

    X ↦ Ext²(F, Hom(-, X)).

    This file first constructs that expression functorially, including its contravariance in F. The subsequent exact-presentation comparison will identify its value on finiteContravariantDefect K with finiteCovariantDefect K when K is short exact.
